headlines.title: PwC, Merck and Hashgraph test cocoa tracking on Hedera
headlines.signal: CoinDesk, Sep 8: a pilot puts Merck bag markers and Hedera records on cocoa batches so firms can meet EU deforestation rules. PwC Germany designed the workflow. It is a test, not a network-fee forecast, and it does not say HBAR demand changes.

headlines.title: Mina says the Mesa mainnet upgrade activated
headlines.signal: Mina Protocol posted on Sep 3 that the Mesa upgrade activated on mainnet. The o1Labs write-up on Sep 8 says block time went from 180 seconds to 90, zkApps got more on-chain state and actions, and hard forks can now run without manual coordination. No partnership and no listing.

headlines.title: Ethena Pay launches on the App Store, settled on Avalanche
headlines.signal: CoinDesk, Sep 1 9:15am EDT: Ethena Pay is a consumer app with 6% dollar savings and 5% card cashback. Avalanche is the only settlement chain. It opened to 400 users, with a wider beta planned through September. ENA was up about 9% on the headline. Access is still a closed beta.
